# What is Xiaohongshu (RedNote, XHS)? A Complete Guide to China’s Hottest Social Media App

*   Edited: February 26 2025
*   Posted by Ker Wei Qi

If you’re in the world of [social media marketing](https://www.oom.com.sg/social-media-management/), you’ve probably heard of Xiaohongshu—or maybe by its international name, RedNote. Often dubbed “China’s Instagram-Pinterest hybrid,” this app is gaining attention for its combination of lifestyle content and e-commerce, creating new opportunities for users and brands alike. 

With over 300 million users and a growing presence outside China, including a surge in U.S. users due to potential TikTok bans, Xiaohongshu is quickly becoming a global marketing goldmine. Even in Singapore, the platform is gaining traction, making it an essential tool for businesses looking to tap into Chinese-speaking consumers and trend-savvy shoppers.

Ready to learn more? In this comprehensive guide, we dive into everything you need to know about Xiaohongshu, why it is so influential, and how you can leverage it.

* * *

## What is Xiaohongshu?

Originally launched in 2013 as a travel and shopping guide, Xiaohongshu has evolved into a full-fledged social media and e-commerce platform. Think of it as a mix between Instagram, Pinterest, and Amazon, where users share and discover content while shopping within the app.

Unlike traditional e-commerce sites, the app thrives on user-generated content (UGC). Shoppers turn to the platform not just to browse products but to read authentic reviews, watch tutorials, and get recommendations from real users.

For international markets, Xiaohongshu has adopted the name RedNote, reflecting its ambition to become a global lifestyle platform.

* * *

## Who Owns Xiaohongshu?

Xiaohongshu, founded by Miranda Qu and Charlwin Mao in 2013, has attracted major investors such as Alibaba, Tencent, and Sequoia China over the years. By July 2024, its valuation had soared to an impressive [$17 billion](https://www.reuters.com/technology/stake-sale-talks-value-chinas-tiktok-rival-xiaohongshu-20-billion-bloomberg-news-2025-01-16/), backed by venture capital giants like Hillhouse Investment and Hongshan Capital. What’s more, the platform achieved a net profit of US$500 million on revenues of US$3.7 billion in 2023, highlighting its rapid growth and profitability.

Simply put, the app is here to stay.

# Xiaohongshu Marketing

## Why Xiaohongshu?

Xiaohongshu (also known as RedNote) is one of China’s leading social platforms, boasting over 300 million monthly active users and over 100 million monthly content creators—70% of whom are women, 35% are Gen Z and 50% Millennials. Notably, 50% of users are based in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities, representing a highly influential and consumption-driven audience. For global brands entering the China market, Xiaohongshu is the critical link in the “Inspire(种草)–Search(搜索)–Purchase(购买)” journey. We help overseas brands reach high-spending consumers, localise content effectively, and turn exposure into measurable sales.

## Content Synergy on Xiaohongshu

![](https://digital-business-lab.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Globe-icon.png)

BGC = Brand-generated content

Publish brand stories, product info, and promotions to establish a professional and consistent image.

![](https://digital-business-lab.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Web3-KOL-Marketing-Icon.png)

KGC = KOL-generated content

KGC leverages influencers—both top-tier KOLs and relatable mid-tier KOCs—to expand reach and build trust.

UGC = User-generated content

Quality UGC often gains algorithmic traction, increasing organic visibility, while timely engagement enhances community participation and strengthens overall credibility.

Works in Synergy

Together, BGC, KGC and UGC create a closed-loop growth engine that not only drives conversions, but continuously feeds back into the brand’s content ecosystem for sustained performance.

## Our Methodology

Establish a Strong Official Presence

Through well-crafted BGC (Brand-Generated Content), we establish your authority, create brand familiarity, and lay a foundation for future amplification.

Implement a Localised Content Strategy

We integrate popular Xiaohongshu expressions and culturally relevant themes to avoid translation pitfalls and connect authentically with your audience. The strategy combines BGC, KGC, and interactive formats to maximize relevance and engagement.

Build Social Proof Through Word of Mouth

We encourage UGC (User-Generated Content) by launching community-driven campaigns, incentivising reviews, and engaging with active users to foster organic conversations that influence purchase intent.

Boost your content

To ensure your content reaches the right audience at scale, we strategically boost high-performing BGC and KGC using Xiaohongshu’s native ad platform (Juguang).

Monitor, Optimize, and Scale

Performance reviews allow us to iterate based on insights, refine content direction, and scale successful tactics. Our goal is not just visibility, but sustainable, conversion-driven growth.
